blocks.heading: Longfu88 iOS and Android Shortcut Checklist
blocks.summary: Why no file is needed and the shortcut steps for iOS in Safari and Android in Chrome.
blocks.notes: Three parts in ONE continuous section without sub-headings, in this order. (1) Two or three sentences: the casino works in the browser of a smartphone or tablet and a home-screen shortcut is added once; one sentence says that nobody needs an installation file or an APK because the casino opens in the mobile browser and is added to the home screen as a shortcut (no file and no store listing); where the phrase "Longfu88 apk" is used it stands in that sentence. (2) Android: one lead-in sentence, then a NUMBERED list with the three steps in the order of the Brand Information (open the casino website in Chrome; open the browser menu and choose Add to Home screen; confirm the shortcut). (3) iOS: one lead-in sentence, then a NUMBERED list with the three steps in the order of the Brand Information (open the casino website in Safari; tap Share and choose Add to Home Screen; confirm Add). The tracked keywords belong to the sentences before the lists; write "the site" or "the casino website" in the steps instead of the brand name. Do not give a download link, file size or version number. Put the iOS list before the Android list. Do not say or imply that a native app, an APK or IPA file, a file download, an app-store listing (Google Play, App Store), a version number, push notifications, fingerprint or Face ID login, an offline mode, an in-app chat, or system requirements (OS versions, storage, memory, internet speed) exist: none of them is given. Mobile access is the responsive website in the browser of a smartphone or a tablet, plus a home-screen shortcut.
